items.statement: A generation increment makes prior attempts, safe points, and blocked projections stale and non-resumable, but the excerpt does not say how already-running workers are cancelled, how their late events are fenced, or how completed external side effects and workspace mutations are reconciled before the new generation dispatches.
items.title: Replan invalidation has no active-side-effect reconciliation protocol
